events.description: It's never too early to book your holiday fun! Especially when it involves big hair, bigger music, and Christmas nostalgia served with a generous helping of 1980s ridiculousness. Remember when your biggest responsibility during the Christmas season was circling everything you wanted in the Toys "R" Us catalog and then casually leaving it on the kitchen table where your parents could "accidentally" find it? There were no online wish lists. No Amazon. No "Your package has been delayed." You had a catalog, a red crayon, and a dream. 🎁 Well, we're bringing that Christmas back!

events.description: Dead North is a progressive bluegrass band from the northwoods of Michigan’s Keweenaw Peninsula. Now residing in Minneapolis, the band is comprised of Luke Pascot (guitar, vocals, banjo), Kora Melia (mandolin, fiddle, vocals), and Nate Miller (bass, vocals). Their sound elegantly mixes bluegrass with elements of jazz, rock, country, funk, and so much more.

events.description: Grab your thermos, drill a hole in the ice, and settle in for the hilarious musical comedy about friendship, fishing, and frozen winters. More than just a play, Guys on Ice is a musical tribute to the stubborn resilience of Midwesterners.

events.title: Will Hoge
events.description: For two decades, Will Hoge has carried the torch for American rock & roll, carving out his own blue-collar sound rooted in amplified guitars, melodic hooks, southern soul, and rootsy stomp. Martin Sexton
events.description: America comes together in the music of Martin Sexton. Our hearts mend, our political and philosophical differences melt away, and the various strains of our roots music entangle. Of Sexton, The New York Times says: “His unpretentious heartiness helps him focus on every soul singer’s goal: to amplify the sound of the ordinary heart." Sexton has remained true to his mission of sharing peace and harmony throughout his 10 albums, and in countless incendiary live performances. He has thus built a loyal following of fans, including critics and superstar artists.

events.title: Kray Van Kirk
events.description: A fine finger-style guitarist with a precise baritone, Kray Van Kirk has a Ph.D. from the University of Alaska, but he set science aside to write songs and tell stories. “There is a reason for hero stories," he says, hidden in plain sight and cloaked in the everyday. The dragons look different, the monsters wear suits, the quest hides behind the mundane and appears utterly futile, but the work is the same. Defeat Empire! Build Utopia!"

events.title: Autism Walk - Northland
events.description: The 2nd Annual Autism Walk Northland MN is a community-centered event created to celebrate, support, and uplift the autism and neurodivergent community. Taking place Sunday, May 22nd at the DECC, this walk brings together families, friends, educators, caregivers, and advocates in a space built on acceptance, connection, and understanding. This event is about more than fundraising. It is about visibility, belonging, and creating a place where every individual feels seen and valued.

events.title: Pike Lake Races
events.description: Get ready for the ultimate summer running experience at the Pike Lake Races presented by Cirrus—where the miles are epic, the party is electric, and the lakeside vibes are totally worth it. Whether you’re lining up for your first 5K, gunning for a PR, or getting a solid tune-up for your marathon goals, this event has it all. Just minutes from Duluth, Pike Lake delivers rolling hills, unbeatable views, and a finish line celebration straight out of your favorite summer memories.

events.title: Going Bananas Run - Duluth
events.description: Get Ready to Go Bananas, Duluth! This isn’t your normal 5K. Actually, it’s not even a 5K. The Going Bananas Run Duluth is a roughly two-mile fun run where hundreds of people take over the streets of Duluth dressed head to toe as bananas. Yes, bananas. Run it. Walk it. Bring the kids. Get a group of friends together. Try to win the whole thing. We really don’t care how you do it. The whole point is to have a ridiculously fun time while raising money for a great local cause.

Abby Spencer Music: Abby Spencer & Leah Rachuj Duo at Dead Squirrel
events.description: Abby Spencer is not a new name in music. She has a unique sound which has been developing since she was just 10 years old. And chances are if you’re into the Wisconsin Dells area nightlife you probably have already been introduced. She has opened for national acts like Thompson Square, David Nail, Madison County, The Plott Hounds and more. In 2018, Abby opened more doors by soloing around the Midwest in various venues. She considers herself as country with a gritty undertone, and identifies with artists like Ashley McBryde, Miranda Lambert, and Cody Johnson.
